newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks rebound at noon on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks rebound at noon on fresh buying.

text.p: Pakistan stocks rebounded after a weak start on Thursday on fresh buying by local institutions and foreign investors, and dealers said the index would consolidate at these levels.
"After the recent rise in blue chips, now buying interest has developed in other stocks as well," dealer Usama Shoaib said. "Energy, cement and bank stocks are in demand."
The index rose 4.02 points, or 0.23 percent, to 2,031.52 at midday. Gains led losses 92 to 43. Adamjee Insurance rose 2.0 rupees to 122 and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.75 to 42.50.
